title: Vibrant Smoked Norwegian Salmon Bowl
description: A Buddhist-temple-friendly, sashimi-cut, hot smoked Norwegian salmon dish served in a lacquerware bowl, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F to toast the sesame seeds.
Spread the sesame seeds on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes, or until fragrant.
Cook the jasmine rice according to package instructions.
Prepare the pickled ginger by thinly slicing it and soaking it in rice vinegar for at least 30 minutes.
Slice the cucumber and carrots into thin strips and set aside.
Flake the hot smoked Norwegian salmon into small pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and rice vinegar to make the dressing.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked jasmine rice between two lacquerware bowls.
Top the rice with the flaked salmon, pickled ginger, cucumber, carrots, and green onions.
Drizzle the dressing over the top of each bowl and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
